# Jonathan (jochris) - Developer Portfolio

Personal portfolio of Jonathan (jochris), featuring backend services, tools, and libraries built in Go, Java, and Rust.

## Public Projects
* Gorvix: Game server management panel in Go running Docker instances with a live WebSocket console. Repo: https://github.com/jochris/Gorvix
* JaWa: Java library for WhatsApp Web Multi-Device protocol using Protobuf, plus modular client bot (JaWa-Bot). Repo: https://github.com/jochris/JaWa
* Gowa: Modular WhatsApp automation bot in Go with plugin architecture. Repo: https://github.com/jochris/Gowa
* LunePaste: Web tools platform for code snippets, cloud storage, shortlinks, and utilities. Live: https://lunee.lol
* Bannix: Linux IPS daemon written in Rust and C with netlink sockets. Fixed log parsing order to prevent IP ban manipulation. Repo: https://github.com/Galang-Purnama/bannix

## Web Services
* Astralune (https://astralune.cv): Digital agency providing website development, web applications, and conversational AI chatbots.
* LuneTools (https://lunee.lol): All-in-one developer suite for code snippets, cloud storage, fast shortlinks, and media tools.
